name: Browser Ref MCP
author: zy2755
description: Reliable browser-control MCP server for AI agents: click by ref, self-healing sessions.

localizations.name: 浏览器 Ref 控制
localizations.description: 让 AI 直接操作你本机已有的 Chrome/Edge：页面快照带编号 ref，按 ref 点击而不靠易碎的 CSS 选择器，浏览器挂了下次调用自动重启并恢复标签页。

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL. Returns a snapshot of interactive elements with [eN] refs that feed straight into click/type. Adds https:// when the protocol is missing.

newTab.description: Open in a new tab (default false: navigate the current tab)

snapshot.description: Include a snapshot in the result (default true)

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Semantic snapshot of the current page: interactive elements carry [eN] refs, and iframe content is flattened in. Narrow it with rootRef (the subtree of a single element), selector, or filter:interactive (interactive elements only).

filter.description: balanced (default) keeps structure and text, interactive keeps only interactive elements, text keeps only text

selector.description: Snapshot only the subtree matching this CSS selector (main document)

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element (prefer the ref from a snapshot). Waits until it is actionable, re-resolves refs that went stale, and returns a fresh snapshot afterwards. Dialogs are handled and reported automatically.

ref.description: The [eN] id shown in a snapshot

selector.description: CSS selector (fallback when no ref is available)

snapshot.description: Include a snapshot after clicking (default true)

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into a field (clears it first). submit:true presses Enter. Works with input/textarea/contenteditable.

clear.description: Clear the field first (default true; false appends)

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a key, e.g. Enter / Tab / ArrowDown / Control+a. With a ref, focuses that element first.

key.description: Key name, e.g. Enter, Escape, ArrowDown, Control+a

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.description: Select options in a dropdown. values may be option values or visible labels; both are tried.

values.description: Option value(s) or visible label(s) to select

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Hover an element to reveal hover-only menus or tooltips.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page, or one scroll container when a ref is given. Direction plus pixel amount.

ref.description: Scroll this container instead (the one marked scrollable in a snapshot)

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot the viewport, the full page, or a single element (ref). Returns the image and writes it to disk.

fullPage.description: Capture the full page instead of the viewport

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Escape hatch: run JS in the page and return a JSON-serializable result. Pass a function string such as `() => document.title` or `() => {...}`; with a ref the function runs on that element as `(el) => el.value`.

ref.description: Run on this element; it becomes the first callback argument

tools.name: browser_wait
tools.description: Wait for a condition: timeMs (fixed delay) / text (appears) / selector (appears) / url (changes) / idle (network quiet). Combine them freely.

text.description: Wait until this text appears on the page

url.description: Wait until the URL matches this pattern

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: Manage tabs: list / new / select (by the index or id that list shows) / close.

index.description: Target tab index for select/close (as shown by list, 0-based)

tools.name: browser_get_info
tools.description: Browser health: mode, tab list, restart count, recent errors / dialogs / downloads. Never launches the browser.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close the browser (launch mode quits it but keeps profile logins; connect mode only disconnects). The next tool call restarts it automatically.
